name: web-ui-playbook
description: Self-contained UI/UX plugin for non-designers: three skills — web-ui-playbook (websites, landing pages, dashboards and forms with a design commitment, tokens first, and a self-audit for contrast, generic-page tells and real browser rendering), brand-color-system (brand palettes with WCAG-checked light/dark tokens in Tailwind, shadcn, CSS-variable, WordPress theme.json, SCSS and DTCG formats) and brand-logo-studio (logos, favicons and brand kits with correct Persian shaping). One design core with adapters for Laravel, Next.js, WordPress and static HTML (guidance for Vue/Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, React SPAs), plus Persian/RTL rules and Iran-market rules (Vazirmatn, Persian digits, ZWNJ, Jalali, Toman, SMS-OTP, Shaparak/eNamad, no foreign CDNs).
